## Prior agreement

Link to the maintainer's explicit agreement on this change and its scope:

<!-- An issue alone is not approval. Unsolicited PRs may be closed without review.
Read CONTRIBUTING.md before submitting. -->

- [ ] The maintainer agreed to this contribution before implementation.
- [ ] This PR stays within the agreed scope.
- [ ] I reviewed and understand all changes, including any generated code.

## What changes?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Explain any user-visible change.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Keep automated checks separate from desktop testing. If you changed window behavior, include the apps, template, display setup, and mouse or keyboard steps tested.

## Compatibility

Mention any effect on saved data, permissions, signing, or the Settings helper. Write "None" if there is no effect.
